Hi Priya — Ben here from Access & Identity. Appreciate the data; that Set-Cookie line and the _redir_hint cookie explains the behavior. We rolled a minor redirect helper last month that sets a cookie on certain flows to preserve backward-compat for long-lived customers. Unfortunately that cookie can cause the enroll path to be rewritten to the legacy host for specific tenant slugs.

Immediate workaround (safe to try now):
1) Open the invite URL in a new private/incognito window (this prevents existing cookies from being used).
2) If that still redirects, clear cookies for "*.redwood.com" in your browser and retry.
3) Alternatively, append the query flag &force_new=enroll to the invite URL which bypasses the legacy rewrite for that request. Example: https://supplier.redwood.com/enroll?v=invite&id=inv_6f3a9a2b&tenant=veloria-dynamics&force_new=enroll

Longer term: we’ve filed JIRA PRC-4598 to remove the tenant-based legacy rewrite for supplier invites. Dev is scheduled to pick this up next week; I added your headers and the screenshot to the ticket. I’ll keep this thread updated.

Can you confirm if the incognito/force_new option allows Veloria to accept the PO? If yes, we can have your finance team proceed while we patch the rewrite rule.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
